# Graph operations · palette

Ports, defaults, and constraints come from the registered operations. Use `graph describe <op> --json` for the full structured record.

### palette.recipe



Origin: toolkit.

| Direction | Port | Type | Default | Details |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `definition` | `record` | Required | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |
| Output | `value` | `palette` | — | {"minItems":1,"maxItems":256,"entries":"RGB integer, #rrggbb or normalized RGB triple"} |
| Output | `roles` | `record` | — | {"layout":"Plain named object"} |

Guides: [guide](../headless-authoring.md#resolve-an-image-to-swatches)

Get the runnable example with `ink-studio graph describe palette.recipe --example > example.json`.
Run it with `ink-studio graph run example.json`.
